channel.title: Books on Pods
channel.description: Books on Pods is a listening companion for serious readers. Each series takes one work, a novel, a nonfiction book, a play, or a collection of stories, poems or essays, and moves through it in conversation. Two hosts talk the work through section by section, the key passages are read aloud in character voices, and the discussion draws in what critics, scholars, translators and directors have said about it, including where they disagree. Alongside the classics, the feed follows recent award winners such as the Booker, the Pulitzer and the National Book Award, so new books get the same close reading as old ones. Episodes run about fifteen minutes and are built to be heard on a walk, a run or a commute.
channel.itunes:summary: Close-reading conversations on fiction, nonfiction, plays and collections, classic and newly awarded, with the text read aloud and the critics brought in.
channel.itunes:author: BooksonPods
